protocol.purpose: Repair request termination separately from frozen bitrate selection
protocol.target_rule: Every session must complete and meet both timing limits
limitations: Simulator only; native browser recovery not implemented
Known sessions; no untouched test or new video
Finite observed-goodput replay, not a causal network model
Failed bodies restart in full; no HTTP Range resumption
Policy history includes received bytes from failed attempts
All settings fixed before replay; no selection using these results

provenance.network_model: finite application-goodput replay; no TCP/QUIC/radio/packet model
provenance.quality_model: playback-duration-weighted log bitrate proxy; not VMAF/MOS
provenance.latency_metric: live edge minus playhead; wall-time weighted after startup, including stalls
